item.title: Porteous takes sole lead at Cell C Challenge
item.description: Haydn Porteous held onto his top spot on the leaderboard in the Cell C Challenge and will take a three-stroke lead into the weekend at Killarney Country Club.

item.title: Teen shares La Quinta lead with Scheffler
item.description: Teenager Blades Brown fired a spectacular 12-under-par 60 to join world No 1 Scottie Scheffler atop the leaderboard after two rounds of the PGA Tour's American Express.

item.title: Veteran pro makes costly amateur error
item.description: Veteran American golfer Brian Harman was left shaking his head after committing a rare and costly error during the opening round of the American Express pro-am in California on Thursday.

item.title: Reed pulls clear at Dubai Desert Classic
item.description: Former Masters champion Patrick Reed opened a four-shot lead going into the final round of the Dubai Desert Classic.

item.title: Porteous leads at Killarney as Van Wyk makes a move
item.description: Haydn Porteous is hunting his first victory of the new year as he takes a three-stroke lead into Sunday’s final round of the Cell C Challenge.

item.title: Kim Si-woo leads Scheffler, Brown in La Quinta
item.description: South Korean Kim Si-woo will have world No 1 Scottie Scheffler and teen phenom Blades Brown nipping at his heels as he takes a one-shot lead into the final round of the PGA Tour's American Express

item.title: Reed glides to victory in Dubai Desert Classic
item.description: LIV Golf star Patrick Reed took his fourth title on the DP World Tour, winning the $9-million Dubai Desert Classic by four shots on Sunday.

item.title: Follett-Smith claims glory in Cell C Challenge
item.description: Zimbabwe’s Benjamin Follett-Smith claimed his third Sunshine Tour title when he won the Cell C Challenge in Honour of Gary Player.

item.title: Scheffler marches to season-opening PGA Tour win
item.description: World No 1 Scottie Scheffler launched his 2026 PGA Tour campaign with a runaway victory in the American Express at La Quinta, California.

item.title: Iceman De Bruin wins SA Amateur Proudfoot Trophy
item.description: Dewan de Bruin produced a moment of pure class to claim the Proudfoot Trophy in the South African Amateur Championship.
